items.text:
Ospreys Announce @SHG_swansea as Hospitality and Catering Partner as The Aviary Launches at St Helen’s 😋

A trusted local operator with six venues across Swansea Bay, the group has built a strong reputation for food, hospitality and service across the region, and will now bring that experience to St Helen’s. 

As part of the agreement, The Secret Hospitality Group will oversee the club’s hospitality catering, bringing quality food and service to the club. Alongside the new catering partnership, the Ospreys are delighted to introduce The Aviary, a brand-new marquee at St Helen’s that will serve as the stadium’s flagship hospitality space on match-days. 

Read more: https://t.co/hJMaIUaDW9 📰 

#OurBloodIsBlack
